maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from dealer subscriptions for listings, advertising and digital marketing software, not repair or servicing of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private auto dealers and automakers advertising on its online car marketplace; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through dealer subscriptions and product launches; acquisitions like Dealer Inspire and FUEL were occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Dealers can shift listing and advertising spend to rival marketplaces like CarGurus or Autotrader; though Dealer Inspire websites add some stickiness.

notes: Dealer website and software products (Dealer Inspire) are stickier than the marketplace listings.
